sentences.en: I didn't read the paper, but I read the abstract.
sentences.zh: 我没有读那篇文章，但我看了摘要。

sentences.en: The new theory is too abstract for ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 这个新理论对于普通人来说太过抽象。

sentences.en: I have difficulty understanding abstract modern art, especially Mondrian.
sentences.zh: 我很难理解抽象的现代艺术，尤其是蒙德里安的作品。

senses.zh: 摘要；提取；使……抽象化；转移(注意力、兴趣等)；使心不在焉

mnemonic: abs+tract（拉）→从原文中拉出来→摘要
